description: Issues #223 / #224, the fail-closed half of the three new fields — accepting a KEY and accepting any VALUE for it are different things, and the second is where the feature would quietly stop being one. #371 asks for two retries: the ceiling IS the feature (enough re-runs turn any red green), so 2 is a config error rather than a longer retry. #372 declares `flakyIsPass: true` with no retry — a declaration that can never fire, which reads as "flakes are tolerated here" while changing nothing. #373 names a mutex that is not safe as a path segment; both runners turn the name into `<root>/<name>.lock`. Each is caught by the PLANNER, while the author is still looking at the block, and `acceptance_gates` is left null rather than rounded to "there was no block". #374 is the CONTROL: the same pairing rule, written in the other order. A YAML mapping has no order, so refusing it would refuse a block CommandMate's own parser accepts — the rule is checked once the entry has been read, not line by line.

warning_details_include: #371: The `acceptance-gates` block could not be read: gate "issue-371-unit" declares retryOnFail "2", and only 0 or 1 are allowed

#372: The `acceptance-gates` block could not be read: gate "issue-372-unit" declares flakyIsPass: true without retryOnFail: 1; without a retry a gate can never be FLAKY, so the declaration could never take effect
#373: The `acceptance-gates` block could not be read: gate "issue-373-e2e" declares mutex "e2e/port", which must match ^[A-Za-z0-9_.-]+$
It is NOT treated as absent
